about: [O8] the AI that shows (the bed, ?start=cast.intent): each man shows what he means before he does it, the reaction the step its cause comes - a witness points at me the step he sees the man go down and goes to tell it ~0.9 s later; a cop sent to me holds his palm out the step he says 'Hands up.'; a gang's three each put a hand into the coat at once and the gun comes out 0.3 - 0.6 s after. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o8/intent.json

steps.expect: (() => { const t = G.castBed.intent.t; return t.point - t.punch < 0.2 && t.witGo - t.point > 0.5 && t.witGo - t.point < 1.5; })()
steps.label: the witness: his arm out at me within 0.2 s of the blow, then he goes (0.5 - 1.5 s on)

steps.expect: (() => { const t = G.castBed.intent.t; return t.halt != null && Math.abs(t.halt - t.handsUp) < 0.2; })()
steps.label: the cop: his palm out with 'Hands up.'

steps.expect: (() => { const t = G.castBed.intent.t; return [0, 1, 2].every((i) => t['reach' + i] != null && t['reach' + i] - t.hostile < 0.2 && t['draw' + i] - t['reach' + i] > 0.25); })()
steps.label: the three: each hand into the coat within 0.2 s, the gun out a quarter second or more after
